sourceCopy.name: Gold Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Gold Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Calculate fine-gold content by weight and purity, then estimate value with your own price. Free, no account, no live quote.
sourceCopy.intro: Convert a gold item’s weight and karat or purity into fine-gold content. Add your own price per gram of pure gold only if you want an illustrative value estimate.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I calculate the value of gold?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Convert the item weight to grams and multiply by its purity fraction to estimate fine-gold weight. If you enter a price per gram of pure gold, the tool multiplies that price by the fine-gold weight and can apply your chosen premium or discount.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does this tool fetch live gold prices or upload my values?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The tool does not fetch market prices or upload your inputs. Any price is entered by you and is only an assumption for arithmetic.

additionalFaqs.question: How much pure gold is in 10 g of 18-karat gold?
additionalFaqs.answer: 18-karat gold is 18/24, or 75%, gold by mass. Ten grams therefore contain an estimated 7.5 g of fine gold.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this show today’s gold price?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. Enter a price yourself. The result is arithmetic based on that assumption, not a real-time market quote or a buyer’s offer.

additionalFaqs.question: What is the difference between ounces and troy ounces?
additionalFaqs.answer: An avoirdupois ounce is about 28.3495 g; a troy ounce is about 31.1035 g. Gold-market weights commonly use troy ounces, so select the unit that matches your item.
